name: Nahari (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nahari town emblem in white: a winged device above a ring enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Nahari, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Nahari town emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing three vertical bars
